name: Otterbein University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-27 cost of attendance from otterbein.edu/financial-aid/affordability/: tuition $37,516 + student fees $524 = $38,040 tuition & fees. Housing published only as combined 'Housing and Meals' $13,674 (room + board); a room-only figure is not separately published on the affordability page.
